description: This file implements the VoiceControl plugin class, providing JSON-RPC methods for voice session management, configuration, and status inquiry, along with handling IARM event subscriptions and events related to voice sessions.

classes.name: VoiceControl
classes.description: Main plugin class handling voice control functionalities, event handling, and JSON-RPC method registration.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin, sets up IARM connections.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources, unregisters event handlers.

methods.name: getApiVersionNumber
methods.description: Returns the current API version number.

methods.name: voiceStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the current voice status information.

methods.name: voiceSessionByText
methods.description: Deprecated method for initiating voice session by text transcription.

methods.name: voiceSessionRequest
methods.description: Starts a voice session with provided parameters.

methods.name: voiceSessionAudioStreamStart
methods.description: Starts audio streaming for voice session.

methods.name: onSessionBegin
methods.description: Event handler for session begin event.

methods.name: onStreamBegin
methods.description: Event handler for stream begin event.

methods.name: onKeywordVerification
methods.description: Event handler for keyword verification event.

methods.name: onServerMessage
methods.description: Event handler for server message event.

methods.name: onStreamEnd
methods.description: Event handler for stream end event.

methods.name: onSessionEnd
methods.description: Event handler for session end event.
